notes.ruler: Interim, not measured under the configuration it describes. RULER runs twenty categories with --max-tokens 0: every length and task except 128k/cwe, at ten items each. Narrowing to the five that discriminate was considered and rejected, because selecting categories by how they scored moves ruler from 96.67% to 80.00%. Over those categories in the 2026-08-19 arms, still under the old 131072 cap, mean prompt was 66,210 and mean output 86,767 (baseline) and 89,961 (candidate). Without the cap the 32k items that were truncating have 229,517 tokens of room, so 100000 is that floor rounded up rather than a measurement. Re-run build_token_priors.py over the first narrowed run directory and replace this. Over-reserving idles the pool; under-reserving preempts, which is the more expensive mistake here.
